heading: Atlanta same-day USCIS medical exam booking: what actually speeds this up
i693_document_requirements: Bring photo ID, immigration paperwork, and any vaccine or TB documentation you already have.
vaccination_handling_notes: Ask whether missing vaccines are handled onsite or referred out, because that is one of the biggest packet-delay variables.
bilingual_support: If language support matters, confirm what is available during both scheduling and form review.
appointment_booking_notes: Ask the office to walk through booking, exam, labs, vaccines, and packet release in one sequence instead of just quoting an appointment time.
Ask whether same-day language means appointment availability, completed labs, or sealed packet readiness.
Booking flow: verify USCIS designation, ask total cost, confirm documents/vaccine records, schedule exam, complete labs/vaccines, then pick up sealed packet after final review.
